category_edits.rationale: Test broader interest retention across all four datasets by increasing causal pooling weight to 0.3 and half-life to eight interactions. Preserve padding exclusion, causal prefixes, final-real-position inference, and the existing GRU architecture and training configuration.

change_summary: Use 0.7 GRU state plus 0.3 causal interest mean with half-life eight during training and inference. Update checkpoint metadata and generated predictor validation consistently; retain one model per category.
